modes.stdio-workspace: npx -y aqua-mcp-server --workspace <dir>: the companion tool set on one local encrypted workspace, plus the public catalog tools.
modes.stdio-catalog: npx -y aqua-mcp-server with no workspace open yet: public catalog tools and resources, plus the setup tools (locate_workspace, init_workspace, doctor). init_workspace switches to stdio-workspace.
modes.hosted: https://aquaidp.xyz/mcp (Streamable HTTP, no auth, rate-limited): public catalog tools, resources and prompts only.

tools.name: add_question
tools.description: Manually index one question in an application with its exact source wording — for fields the extractor missed or fields added after a later capture.

tools.name: approve_answer
tools.description: Never executes.

tools.name: assemble_application
tools.description: Build a Markdown application from explicitly chosen APPROVED answer versions plus the unresolved fields and provenance.

tools.name: attach_evidence
tools.description: Stage an evidence record for a file — from inbox/, or uploaded as file_name + content_base64, or identified by file_sha256 alone (only the hash is recorded) — and optionally link it to a version.

tools.name: attest_submission
tools.description: Never executes.

tools.name: create_draft_version
tools.description: Stage a NEW, unapproved draft version of an answer in this workspace (method recorded as an agent draft).

tools.name: discover_applications
tools.description: Search the cached public AQUA catalog (approved programs) and list the applications in this workspace.

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Self-check: Node and companion version, the public catalog configuration (source, origin, key role: only anon/publishable is accepted), connectivity and a canonical-only catalog read (counts only), workspace and macOS Keychain status.

tools.name: export_packet
tools.description: Never executes.

tools.name: get_application_details
tools.description: Full template of one application: exact question wording, parsed requirements (limits, required, time context, qualifiers), deadline and time zone, and where the data came from and how it was verified.

tools.name: hub_find_similar_questions
tools.description: Find canonical questions in the approved catalog that ask about the same thing as the given text (lexical similarity over question wording and its recorded variants; no embeddings, nothing stored).

tools.name: hub_get_acceptance_stats
tools.description: Public acceptance figures for one approved canonical program: acceptance rate and application count where public, and counts of verified applicant-reported outcomes by cohort (counts only, never who reported).

tools.name: hub_get_heat_scores
tools.description: Approved canonical programs ranked by heat score (current applicant interest and deadline pressure).

tools.name: hub_get_program_by_slug
tools.description: One approved canonical program by slug with its public stats and theme weights (DNA) in a single call.

tools.name: hub_get_program_detail
tools.description: Full public detail for one approved canonical program by program_id or slug: deadlines, cycles, rolling/cohort, value and acceptance figures where public.

tools.name: hub_get_program_questions
tools.description: The application questions of one approved canonical program in display order: exact wording (in untrusted_content), word and character limits, required flag, theme, and how many approved programs ask the same canonical question.

tools.name: hub_get_program_rankings
tools.description: Approved canonical programs ranked by program value score (what you get versus what you give up, relative to application effort).

tools.name: hub_get_program_themes
tools.description: Theme weight breakdown of one approved canonical program (what it emphasizes, from its questions), by program_id or slug.

tools.name: hub_get_question_significance
tools.description: How much one canonical question matters across approved programs: how many ask it and what share of approved programs that is, typical limits, theme, and which programs ask it.

tools.name: hub_get_universal_questions
tools.description: Canonical questions asked by most approved programs: the ones to answer first.

tools.name: hub_search_programs
tools.description: Search approved canonical AQUA programs (accelerators, grants, fellowships, VC and other programs) by words, type, status, equity, cash, rolling and deadline window.

tools.name: import_history
tools.description: Batch-stage applications the user ALREADY SUBMITTED (a folder inside the workspace inbox/, .md .txt .docx .html .json .csv) as history records: exact question wording, the submitted answer, program, source file sha256 and the submission dat

tools.name: import_local_application
tools.description: Stage a private local application from a file the user placed in the workspace inbox/ folder (.txt, .md, .html, .csv, .json, .docx).

tools.name: init_workspace
tools.description: Create an encrypted AQUA workspace ONLY after the user confirms the folder and consent in the MCP client UI (elicitation).

tools.name: inspect_extracted_questions
tools.description: Show how the questions of a workspace application were extracted: exact wording, parsed requirements, source location, and items the parser was unsure about.

tools.name: link_answer
tools.description: Mark an approved answer version as a direct-reuse candidate for a later question.

tools.name: link_history
tools.description: Record a relevance link between an imported history answer (a submitted, unconfirmed record) and a workspace question.

tools.name: locate_workspace
tools.description: Where the AQUA workspace is (or would be created): whether this server has one open, the configured path, the folders searched, and the exact init command.

tools.name: mark_question
tools.description: Mark a question not_applicable (hidden by an observed branch), skipped (known optional field deliberately left blank), or clear it back to open — always with a reason.

tools.name: match_canonical_questions
tools.description: Match an application's questions (or given question texts) against canonical questions in the cached public catalog with the tiered matcher (exact, normalized, semantic, novel).

tools.name: prepare_catalog_candidate
tools.description: Build a sanitized public catalog candidate (program, deadlines, public question wording only) from a staged application imported with a public source_url.

tools.name: prepare_packet
tools.description: Readiness report for freezing an application packet: per question the selectable approved version, whether its approval is bound to the exact hash, length limits, required questions, and content integrity.

tools.name: present_review_decisions
tools.description: Build the offline AQUA review file (HTML, containing the user's answers in plain text) for one application and save it under exports/reviews/ (at most 25 files are kept; refused under --read-only).

tools.name: read_review_status
tools.description: Derived review status of every question in an application (gap, suggested, needs evidence, under review, approved, ...) and the Direct / Adapt / Gap reuse recommendation against the rest of the answer bank.

tools.name: record_observed_submission
tools.description: Store an observation that an application may have been submitted (for example a confirmation e-mail the user saved in inbox/, or uploaded as file_name + content_base64), flagged requires_human_attestation.

tools.name: refresh_catalog
tools.description: Fetch approved canonical programs, cycles and questions from the configured public AQUA catalog endpoint (read-only, public key, nothing from the workspace is sent).

tools.name: request_evidence
tools.description: Record an evidence gap on a version (what support is missing).

tools.name: search_answer_bank
tools.description: Search the user's private answers, versions, facts and evidence in this workspace (decrypted in memory only).

tools.name: sign_packet
tools.description: Never executes.

tools.name: submit_catalog_candidate
tools.description: Never executes.

tools.name: sync_from_vault_export
tools.description: Import an encrypted backup the user exported from the AQUA browser vault and placed in the workspace inbox/ (the same checks as "aqua-companion import-backup": integrity, account binding, conflicts recorded, nothing overwritten).

tools.name: update_question
tools.description: Add interpretation or correct metadata on a question — summary, general/custom kind, topic, group, required status, limit, visible options — without ever changing the captured source wording.

tools.name: verify_packet
tools.description: Verify an exported AQUA packet JSON placed in inbox/ (or packets/), or uploaded as file_name + content_base64: canonical manifest, manifest hash, packet id, per-answer hashes, provenance receipts and the signature if present.

resources.description: Review status of every application in this workspace (gap, suggested, needs evidence, under review, approved) from read_review_status.
Approved canonical programs: ids, slugs, types, statuses and deadlines. Names are in untrusted_content.
One approved program: exact question wording, word/character limits, required flags, cycles and deadline.
One canonical question: theme, how many approved programs ask it, and their exact wordings.

prompts.name: start-application
prompts.description: Begin an application for one program, given its AQUA slug or its public application URL.

prompts.name: reuse-my-answers
prompts.description: Find answers the user already wrote that fit an application's questions, and stage adapted drafts for review.

prompts.name: get-ready-to-export
prompts.description: Check whether an application is ready to freeze and export, and hand the remaining steps to the user.

intentionally_absent.name: publish_catalog_entry
intentionally_absent.why: Catalog publication needs reviewer authorization and source verification in the AQUA service; the agent can only prepare a candidate.

intentionally_absent.name: run_migration
intentionally_absent.why: Database migrations change production permissions and require explicit owner authorization.

intentionally_absent.name: admin_platform
intentionally_absent.why: Platform administration (users, roles, billing, teams) is not a user capability.

intentionally_absent.name: configure_security
intentionally_absent.why: Security configuration (RLS, keys, service-role access) is owner-only and never handled by agents.

intentionally_absent.name: read_hosted_answers
intentionally_absent.why: Private answers live in the browser vault and this workspace; the agent never gets database or service-role access.

intentionally_absent.name: TRANSPORT=http (self-hosted HTTP)
intentionally_absent.why: 1.x served unauthenticated write-capable HTTP. 2.0 has stdio locally and the read-only hosted endpoint only.

removed_in_2.name: hub_get_profile_answers

removed_in_2.name: hub_search_answer_bank

removed_in_2.name: hub_save_answer_review

removed_in_2.name: hub_set_borrow_threshold

removed_in_2.name: hub_rank_my_answers

removed_in_2.name: hub_stress_test_answer

removed_in_2.name: hub_log_draft_run
removed_in_2.replacement: none: the companion records every tool call in its own audit log

removed_in_2.name: hub_get_fit_score
removed_in_2.replacement: none in 2.0 (needed private hosted answers)

removed_in_2.name: hub_find_best_programs
removed_in_2.replacement: hub_search_programs + hub_get_program_rankings (public), then the workspace tools

removed_in_2.name: hub_get_application_readiness
removed_in_2.replacement: prepare_packet (workspace mode)

removed_in_2.name: aqua.ingest_application

removed_in_2.name: aqua.process_reward
removed_in_2.replacement: none: rewards are processed by the AQUA service, never by an agent

removed_in_2.name: aqua.get_variations
removed_in_2.replacement: hub_find_similar_questions / hub_get_question_significance (public); match_canonical_questions (workspace mode)

removed_in_2.name: aqua.qualify_answer

removed_in_2.name: aqua.get_canonical_package
removed_in_2.replacement: prepare_packet (workspace mode)

removed_in_2.name: aqua.export_package
